sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Described by [[Tantras]] as Kiel's ultimate Titan, Efreet King is powerful enough to run rampage, even with no conscious Seeker to control him. {{Source|S2E40}} Like Kiel's other fire-based Titans, Efreet King can shoot fire from its mouth and eyes. The immense size and power of his flame blasts are powerful enough to overpower the blasts of a [[Legendary Titan]], [[Mythras]], and defeat it. Efreet King's rock like armor is also invulnerable to attacks and was able to remain unscathed when he was attacked with the [[Willblade]]. {{Source|S2E40}} If [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Kipperin|Powerbonded Kipperin]] had not distracted it, this Titan would likely have killed the battle-worn Sophie. It was only defeated by a direct blast from a spectral version of [[Pendragon]]. {{source|S2E40}}

full_text:
Efreet King is a devastating fire-based Litho-Titan that resembles a horned Djinn-like demon whose body is composed of rock and flame. The ultimate destructive Titan belonging to Kiel, Efreet King is one of the few known standard Titans that can fight toe-to-toe with the Legendary Titans.

History

Efreet King was invoked outside the Fortress of Iron Will by a completely depleted Kiel, defeated by Sophie Casterwill, who passed out after summoning him. Efreet King fought and defeated the Legendary Titan, Mythras, by using blasting him with the fire from its eyes. It then advanced on an unconscious Sophie but was interrupted by Lok Lambert and Powerbonded Kipperin who tried to fight him with the Willblade. Lok's attacks had little effect on Efreet King, but he was suddenly defeated by the spirit-like form of Pendragon, summoned as the Casterwill family performed an ancient ritual from within the stronghold in the cave. [The Spiral War]

Abilities

Described by Tantras as Kiel's ultimate Titan, Efreet King is powerful enough to run rampage, even with no conscious Seeker to control him. [S2E40] Like Kiel's other fire-based Titans, Efreet King can shoot fire from its mouth and eyes. The immense size and power of his flame blasts are powerful enough to overpower the blasts of a Legendary Titan, Mythras, and defeat it. Efreet King's rock like armor is also invulnerable to attacks and was able to remain unscathed when he was attacked with the Willblade. [S2E40] If Lok Lambert and Powerbonded Kipperin had not distracted it, this Titan would likely have killed the battle-worn Sophie. It was only defeated by a direct blast from a spectral version of Pendragon. [S2E40]

Trivia

• Efreet King's summoning command is "Come."
• Efreet King is based on the ifrit, a creature from Middle Eastern mythology akin to a djinn or genie.
• In the official YouTube description blurb for the episode "The Spiral War," Efreet King is mistakenly referred to as "King Salamander." This was likely an early production working name.
